title: isostigma peucedanifolium var. speciosum
intro: Isostigma peucedanifolium var. speciosum, commonly known as Yangu or Angelica, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, and its health benefits include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against various diseases and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Yangu include anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-viral effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents of Yangu, including ferulic acid, isoferulic acid, and other phenolic compounds, have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
